narrative:
Warren County has 177,004 registered voters, with 53.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 33.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 12.7%, a pronounced Republican lean of 21.2 percentage points. Gen X are the largest generational cohort at 27.6% of registrants.
